functionRegistry._comment: arch-005 (2026-04-26): wogi-flow's source lives in scripts/ + lib/, not src/. Default scanner config doesn't list scripts/, so function-map.md was empty after every scan. Override the configKey 'functionRegistry' (NOT 'functionIndex' — that's the script name, the config key is different).

taskBoundaryReset._comment_autoPickupNextTask: When true, after a clean task completion + restart, the next SessionStart injects an AUTO-PICKUP block instructing the AI to immediately invoke /wogi-start <nextReadyId> instead of asking 'what's next?'. Skipped if pending-question.json exists or ready queue is empty.

_comment_featureDossier: wf-557cf08a — Feature dossier + logic rules system. Auto-injects per-feature canonical knowledge (rejected alternatives, removed elements, contracts) and cross-cutting logic rules into phase context. enabled: master switch. autoMatchConfidence: minimum match score for a dossier to be injected (0-5). blockOnContradiction: if true, /wogi-story blocks spec approval when the spec contradicts an active dossier. driftCheckOnSessionStart: run drift detector on session start. autoTouchOnDone: on /wogi-done, auto-append a Change Log row to every dossier matching the completed task (guarded by duplicate-row check + per-file lockfile). See .workflow/dossiers/README.md.

skills._comment_fuzzyPatchThreshold: Minimum similarity (0-1) for `flow skill patch --find/--replace` to apply. Below this, the patch is rejected atomically (active skill untouched). Default 0.85 tolerates whitespace/line-ending drift but rejects line reordering and semantic edits.

rules._comment_phaseReadGate: Phase-read gate blocks Edit/Write/Bash until the current phase's instruction file is read. Falls back to phaseGate.enabled when not set (backwards compat).

testing._comment_discovery: Smart test discovery + SWE-bench dual gate for existing project tests

skillLearning._comment_enabled: When true, skill learning extracts patterns from completed work

plugins._comment_phaseInjection: When true, the UserPromptSubmit hook appends available flow-integrated plugin hints to the phase context prompt
plugins._comment_standaloneBypassTask: When true, standalone-mode plugin matches in /wogi-start skip task creation and invoke the plugin directly

mcpCapabilities._comment_enabled: When true, sub-agents receive MCP capability hints based on their role. Requires CC 2.1.101+ (sub-agent MCP inheritance)

gateTelemetry._comment: Per-gate self-assessment log. Every quality/verification/logic gate appends a structured event to .workflow/state/gate-telemetry.jsonl. See .claude/docs/gate-telemetry.md.
gateTelemetry._comment_rotateSizeBytes: Rotate to archive when the active log exceeds this size (default 10 MB)
gateTelemetry._comment_crossReferenceOnCorrection: When the session-correction detector (Story wf-cc4eb238) flags a user correction, mark prior PASS events from IGR gates on the same task as misses.

intentGroundedReasoning._comment: Intent-Grounded Reasoning (IGR). Default ON 2026-04-13. See .claude/docs/intent-grounded-reasoning.md. To disable: set enabled=false.

autoReview._comment: Parallel-worktree Auto-Review (wf-8d635d0e / E1). On coding→validating phase transition, spawns a detached background review worker in an isolated git worktree. Findings write to .workflow/state/auto-review-findings.json; the Completion Truth Gate folds high-severity findings into its downgrade logic. Opt-in (enabled=false by default) because it spawns a background child process. Known limitation: the worker runs on the session's global Claude Code model — per-task model selection is a future Claude Code feature. timeoutMs controls the unverified-review-timeout threshold.

externalMemory._comment: Externalized episodic memory (epic-episodic-memory). Routes noisy tool outputs to disk with breadcrumbs; enforces conclusion capture to state files. Default OFF until Wave E measurement. See .workflow/audits/state-coverage-2026-04-15.md.

thresholds._comment: Size thresholds above which tool outputs are externalized to .workflow/memory/.

retention._comment: Lifecycle policy for .workflow/memory/ files. Eviction runs the promotion pipeline first.

exemptions._comment: Paths and tools that should never be externalized regardless of threshold.

capture._comment: Capture-at-task-boundary enforcement (wf-a3cc5f2a shipped). Set enabled:true to activate the captureGate quality gate. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for the Haiku conclusion classifier; gate skips with warning when key absent.

telemetry._comment: Per-session token-savings measurement. Needed to validate Wave E flag flip.

audit._comment: Project-wide audit settings. The framingPass / evidenceTiers / adversaryPass blocks were added for the IGR-hardening of /wogi-audit — they port the same rigor from /wogi-start (framing, truth-gate evidence grading, and different-model adversary critique) into the audit pipeline.

review._comment: Code-review settings. The framingPass / evidenceTiers / adversaryPass / completionTruthGate blocks mirror the IGR-hardening applied to /wogi-audit. They port the same rigor (framing, evidence grading, different-model adversary, runtime-evidence truth gate) into /wogi-review so review findings can't rubber-stamp themselves. These toggles are AI-honored at runtime (the markdown command enforces them); there is no runtime code reading these keys — pattern matches /wogi-audit's docs-driven command model.

adversaryPass._comment: adversaryModel is NOT a static default — the AI must resolve it at runtime by inspecting which model the review agents used. Rule: adversary model MUST differ from agent model (same-model adversary = rubber-stamp, defeats IGR). whenAgentOnSonnet = opus; whenAgentOnOpus = sonnet; whenAgentOnHaiku = sonnet. Never match.

researchReasoningGate._comment: Research Reasoning Gate (wf-6dbc0b2a). For conversation/research mode: classify the question into Tier 1 (factual, no gate), Tier 2 (domain — surface assumptions, wait for user confirmation), or Tier 3 (architecture — Tier 2 + different-model adversary critique). Classification is by structural markers, not AI self-judgement.

promotion._comment: Promotion pipeline (wf-6a352aae). Scans adversary-runs/*.json + correction-patterns.json for content that should promote into feedback-patterns.md. Auto-runs at session-end (writes pending-promotions.json — interactive `flow promote apply` confirms before write to feedback-patterns.md).

archive._comment: Stale archival (wf-6a352aae). Manual-only — destructive operations stay user-gated. Use `flow archive --dry-run` to preview, `flow archive` to commit.

correctionDetector._comment: Hybrid keyword-first classifier with self-learning back-propagation (wf-e6d65edf). Layer 1 (keyword pre-classifier) skips Haiku on a hit. Layer 2 (AI fallback) runs the existing Haiku path. Layer 3 (learning) extracts n-grams from AI-confirmed corrections at confidence >= learningThreshold and writes them to .workflow/state/correction-patterns.json.
